description: The article argues that EDM methods which incorporate human effort up front — defining and labeling independent variables that \"map to clearly defined constructs\" — produce discoveries that are interpretable and actionable for instruction.
title: Human-in-the-loop feature selection for interpretable educational data mining

description: Human reliability analysis (HRA) is a structured approach that identifies systematically the impact of human error on a system to reduce adverse events.
title: Human reliability analysis via hierarchical task analysis (HTA) and SHERPA

description: The pipeline converts syllabus PDFs to Markdown and uses an LLM through a university-managed API gateway to reconstruct final-grade weights for each assessment category, which feed the continuous GenAI-susceptibility treatment variable.
title: Human-validated LLM reconstruction of syllabus assessment weights

description: The article recommends that LLM-assisted data extraction in research synthesis should only proceed with mandatory human validation of every data point before it is recorded into a coding form.
title: Human validation of LLM-extracted data in research synthesis
